headline: Brazil IGP-M Inflation Slows to 1.47% in October as Primary Deficit Narrows
summary: Brazil's IGP-M inflation index registered 1.47% in October, bank lending expanded 0.4%, and the pre-interest primary budget deficit narrowed to $1.0 billion.
why: The IGP-M index is a benchmark for Brazilian commercial contracts and real estate rentals, influencing interest rate expectations and Brazilian government debt yields.

impacts.name: Brazil 10-year sovereign bond yield
impacts.why: Slowing inflation and a narrowed primary budget deficit affect domestic sovereign bond pricing.
